description: Rotate a video 90, 180 or 270 degrees or mirror it, instantly and losslessly, by writing MP4 rotation metadata (H.264, HEVC, VP9 or AV1). Returns an MP4. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The video file (MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped. The picture must be H.264, HEVC, VP9 or AV1. The result comes back the same way in `data`, as an MP4.

degrees.description: How far to turn the picture clockwise, from the way it is shown now: 90, 180 or 270 (270 is a quarter turn anticlockwise). 0 with a flip only mirrors.

flip.description: Mirror the picture after turning it: horizontal (left and right swap), vertical (top and bottom swap) or none.

name.description: The video's filename. The result is named after it, with -rotated.mp4 on the end.

name: rotate_video
title: Rotate Video
